# pve_oci_repo_tags (Data Source)

Tags of an OCI image repository as queried from a node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_oci_repo_tags" "example" {
node = "pve1"
reference = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `reference` (String) The reference to the repository to query tags from.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>.
- `tags` (List of String) Returned by /nodes/{node}/query-oci-repo-tags.
